summary: Block gsc rg/query/notes/rules unless the required guide was loaded earlier in the session.

changelog.message: Changed topic from agent-lifecycle-rules to tool-gates for better discoverability
Expanded to cover gsc rg, gsc notes, and gsc rules in addition to gsc query
Expanded command_filter to match gsc rg/query/notes/rules; updated instruction with per-command guide requirements

instruction.text: Before using `gsc rg`, load `gsc experts guide visualization`. Before `gsc query`, load `gsc experts guide query`. Before `gsc notes`, load `gsc experts guide notes`. Before `gsc rules`, load `gsc experts guide rules`.

summary: Prefer gsc rg over broad plain rg when Brains are active.
details: Blocks broad repository discovery commands that start with plain `rg` when active GitSense Brains can enrich search results. Allows targeted known-file line lookups, `rg --files`, temp-path searches, parse failures, and Brain discovery failures.

instruction.text: For broad repository discovery, prefer `gsc rg <pattern> --db <brain> --fields purpose` when active Brains are available. Use `gsc rg <pattern> --db <brain> --summary` for aggregate match/file counts. Plain `rg` is acceptable for targeted line lookup in known individual files.

summary: Remind contributors to run the repository check after code changes
details: Source: AGENTS.md:28. This is a delayed session obligation, not a requirement to run the check after every individual edit.
instructions: After completing code changes, run `npm run check` with full output and do not tail it.
Fix all reported errors, warnings, and infos before committing. This check does not run tests.

summary: Remind contributors to run every modified test
details: Source: AGENTS.md:31. The test must be rerun after its latest edit and iterated to passing.
instructions: Run the modified test and iterate on the test or implementation until it passes.

summary: Remind contributors to avoid unsafe broad test commands
details: Source: AGENTS.md:29-30. Full Vitest runs may activate e2e tests when endpoint or authentication environment variables are present.
instructions: Do not run `npm test` or the full Vitest suite unless the user requested it.
For non-e2e tests, run `./test.sh` from the repository root; otherwise run the specific test from its package with `node ../../node_modules/vitest/dist/cli.js --run test/specific.test.ts`.

summary: Require the faux provider harness for coding-agent suite tests
details: Source: AGENTS.md:32. Tests in this suite must not use real provider APIs, credentials, or paid tokens.
instructions: Use `test/suite/harness.ts` with the faux provider. Do not use real provider APIs, keys, or paid tokens.

summary: Use the required naming convention for issue regression tests
details: Source: AGENTS.md:33. This reminder applies when creating a regression in the designated directory.

summary: Use only erasable TypeScript syntax in strip-only code
details: Source: AGENTS.md:18,20. The root configuration runs TypeScript in Node strip-only mode.
instructions: Use top-level imports only; do not add dynamic or inline imports.

Use only erasable TypeScript syntax: no parameter properties, enums, namespaces/modules, `import =`, `export =`, or constructs requiring JavaScript emit. Use explicit fields with constructor assignments.

summary: Redirect model catalog changes to the generator
details: Source: AGENTS.md:24. The generated output may appear in a diff after regeneration but must not be edited directly.
instructions: Do not edit `packages/ai/src/models.generated.ts` directly. Update `packages/ai/scripts/generate-models.ts` and regenerate the catalog instead.

summary: Apply repository dependency and install security requirements
details: Source: AGENTS.md:39-43. Dependency manifests and lockfiles are reviewed code and lifecycle scripts require explicit review.
instructions: Pin direct external dependencies to exact versions and treat dependency and lockfile changes as reviewed code.
Use `npm install --ignore-scripts` for local hydration or updates and `npm ci --ignore-scripts` for clean installs. Do not run lifecycle scripts unless the user asks.
After dependency metadata changes, refresh `package-lock.json` with `npm install --package-lock-only --ignore-scripts`.

summary: Regenerate and review the coding-agent shrinkwrap safely
details: Source: AGENTS.md:42-43. New dependencies with lifecycle scripts require review and an explicit allowlist entry; lockfile hook bypass requires user intent.
instructions: Regenerate `packages/coding-agent/npm-shrinkwrap.json` with `node scripts/generate-coding-agent-shrinkwrap.mjs`; verify with `--check` or `npm run check`.
Review new dependencies with lifecycle scripts and add allowlist entries only with explicit approval. Do not bypass the lockfile pre-commit hook unless the user wants the lockfile change committed.

summary: Keep changelog edits inside the Unreleased section
details: Source: AGENTS.md:106-118. Released version sections are immutable and entries use different attribution formats for internal and external work.
instructions: Read the full `[Unreleased]` section first, append to its existing subsection, and never duplicate subsections.
Do not modify released version sections.
Use `Fixed foo ([#123](...))` for internal issues and include `by [@username](...)` for external contributions.

summary: Keep keybindings configurable instead of hardcoding key checks
details: Source: AGENTS.md:23. The selectors cover the current central keybinding and interactive input implementations.
instructions: Do not hardcode key checks. Add defaults to `DEFAULT_EDITOR_KEYBINDINGS` or `DEFAULT_APP_KEYBINDINGS` so bindings remain configurable.
